deep_analysis.name: mattpocock/skills
deep_analysis.headline_hook: Ditch rigid agentic frameworks and take back control with Matt Pocock's composable, engineering-grade AI coding skills.
deep_analysis.core_functionality: Mattpocock/skills provides a collection of small, adaptable, and composable skill definitions designed for CLI-based AI coding agents (like Claude Code and Codex). It solves common failure modes in AI-assisted development—such as requirement misalignment, agent verbosity, lack of feedback loops, and software entropy—by enforcing classic software engineering fundamentals instead of letting agents drive the entire process blind.
key_features: Grilling Sessions (/grill-me and /grill-with-docs): Forces the AI to ask detailed questions and establish a shared domain language/context before generating any code.
Strict TDD Execution (/tdd): Implements disciplined red-green-refactor loops to keep automated testing tightly coupled to agent code generation.
Architecture Surveying (/improve-codebase-architecture): Periodically audits the codebase for deep modules, design opportunities, and architectural drift.
Flexible Installation Philosophies: Allows installation either as a managed, auto-updating Claude Code plugin or via `npx skills@latest add` for full local ownership and hacking.
deep_analysis.target_audience: Professional software engineers, full-stack developers, and technical leads who actively use AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and want strict deterministic control over their workflows rather than relying on black-box 'vibe coding' frameworks.
deep_analysis.practical_developer_value: Developers can eliminate the classic communication gap with LLMs, significantly reduce token wastage caused by ambiguous prompts, and prevent AI-accelerated codebases from degenerating into a 'ball of mud.' By integrating these skills into daily workflows, engineers enforce robust testing, precise specs, and consistent terminology across every coding session.
suggested_use_cases: Pre-flight alignment: Running `/grill-with-docs` before starting a complex feature to clarify requirements, document architecture decisions (ADRs), and establish project jargon.
Refactoring and maintenance: Periodically invoking `/improve-codebase-architecture` to identify system design bottlenecks and deepen software modules.

deep_analysis.name: lnkiai/m3e-canvas
deep_analysis.headline_hook: Bridge the gap between visual UI sketching and AI-driven frontend generation with a browser-based canvas tailored for Material 3 Expressive.
deep_analysis.core_functionality: M3E Canvas solves the ambiguity of text-only prompting in 'vibe-coding' by letting developers and designers visually layout, link, and transition multi-screen Material 3 Expressive UI mockups in the browser, subsequently compiling those visual blueprints into concise, highly actionable natural-language prompts for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
key_features: Magnetic component grouping and real M3 Expressive loading indicators ported directly from Android implementations.
Multi-screen canvas supporting responsive viewports (phone and desktop modes) with interactive tap and swipe navigation flow mapping.
Automated context generation that exports spatial layouts, overlap structures, and component states into multilingual prompts (English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean).
Optional BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) AI integration to auto-write component behaviors and screen notes directly in the browser via localStorage without an intermediary backend.
deep_analysis.target_audience: Frontend developers, mobile app engineers, and AI-first 'vibe-coders' looking to rapidly prototype UI systems before handing them off to LLM coding agents.
deep_analysis.practical_developer_value: Developers save countless iterations trying to describe layout requirements to LLMs through text. By visually dragging and dropping components, establishing screen-to-screen navigation flows, and defining a strict design system (Material 3 Expressive), developers ensure AI coding assistants generate code that matches precise structural, theme, and architectural specifications on the very first try.
suggested_use_cases: Rapidly prototyping cross-platform mobile apps (Android/Web) by sketching screens, setting up navigation states, and prompting Claude Code to scaffold the initial codebase.
Standardizing UI generation across a team by creating consistent visual blueprints and exporting them into localized, AI-ready prompt blocks.

deep_analysis.name: 2akouwu/reverify
deep_analysis.headline_hook: Stop your AI coding and reverse-engineering agents from hallucinating by using a deterministic toolset as an immutable judge.
deep_analysis.core_functionality: Reverify solves the problem of AI hallucination in autonomous coding, reverse engineering, and refactoring by enforcing a deterministic verification loop. Instead of trusting language models to accurately generate APIs, structs, code, or binary offsets, Reverify forces the AI's proposals through a pure-Python (and optionally engine-backed) verification gate that returns VERIFIED or REFUTED with concrete, cryptographic evidence.
key_features: Deterministic Verification Loop: Agents propose claims (e.g., instructions, emulation results, structural offsets), and the deterministic toolset judges them against ground truth, gating pipelines on verified evidence.

Dual-Mode Execution Core: Ships with a zero-dependency pure-Python core for PE/ELF/Mach-O parsing, disassembly, and emulation, with seamless optional upgrades to advanced engines like Capstone, Unicorn, Lief, Z3, and angr.

Model Context Rollover & MCP Native: Includes an MCP server so coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI) can natively invoke verification tools, alongside a rollover mechanism to prevent context rot during long tasks.

Information Weight & Anti-Hallucination Metrics: Evaluates claims not just for correctness, but for information entropy (CORE/FActScore refinement), filtering out boilerplate echoes or trivial assertions.
deep_analysis.target_audience: AI Engineers building autonomous agents, Security Researchers & Reverse Engineers, and Systems Developers automating low-level code analysis and refactoring.
deep_analysis.practical_developer_value: Developers building or using AI coding and analysis agents can eliminate the risk of silent hallucinations corrupting codebases or reverse-engineering efforts. By integrating Reverify's CLI or MCP server into CI/CD pipelines or agent loops, every structural claim, refactor equivalence, or binary hypothesis is programmatically validated against actual source or binary artifacts before being accepted.
suggested_use_cases: Gating automated reverse-engineering and malware-analysis workflows in CI/CD to prevent AI agents from accepting fabricated function signatures, offsets, or prologues.
Validating AI-driven code rewrites and refactoring via behavior equivalence testing across languages like Python and C.
